decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY setting warmup_domain_candidate to the selected domain, so no additional or edited Event is needed.
Selecting a candidate campaign domain does not change the policies for isolated test accounts, existing campaigns, or existing MeetAlfred leads.
The domain candidate does not change MeetAlfred account setup, platform choice, or subscription plan.
The selected domain does not alter silent-lead recirculation, follow-up list export, or campaign cleanup behavior.
Choosing a domain candidate does not change the requirement to keep the ongoing MeetAlfred integration connected.
The domain selection does not change which communication channels are visible in HubSpot lead records.
The selected campaign domain is unrelated to Apollo contact-enrichment data and automation mode.
The domain candidate does not change the deferred HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization or its Zapier integration method.
Selecting a campaign domain does not change the requirement to create and configure the Zapier account.
The domain selection does not resolve or change how existing CRM records are identified to users.
The supplied URL is a campaign-domain candidate, not a LinkedIn or Sales Navigator profile URL, and does not affect CRM profile-link handling.
